fractal_swing_points.definition: N-bar pivot fractal where candle t is highest high of [t-N, t+N] (Swing High) or lowest low of [t-N, t+N] (Swing Low). Default N=2 (5-bar fractal) for M15 and N=3 (7-bar fractal) for H4.
fractal_swing_points.validation: Confirmed only upon close of candle t+N.

market_structure_shift_mss_choch.definition: The first break and close of the most recent significant swing low in an uptrend (Bearish MSS) or most recent swing high in a downtrend (Bullish MSS).
market_structure_shift_mss_choch.requirement: Must be accompanied by impulsive displacement (body close beyond level, not just wick sweep).

break_of_structure_bos.definition: Continuation break in the direction of the established trend. Higher High broken in uptrend, Lower Low broken in downtrend.
break_of_structure_bos.requirement: Candle close outside previous swing fractal level.

fair_value_gap_fvg.bullish_fvg: Candle 1 High < Candle 3 Low (3-candle imbalance). The gap [Candle 1 High, Candle 3 Low] represents inefficient buy-side delivery.
fair_value_gap_fvg.bearish_fvg: Candle 1 Low > Candle 3 High. The gap [Candle 3 High, Candle 1 Low] represents inefficient sell-side delivery.
fair_value_gap_fvg.consequent_encroachment_ce: 50% midpoint of the FVG span: CE = (Gap_High + Gap_Low) / 2.
fair_value_gap_fvg.mitigation_rule: An FVG is active until price trades into it. If price closes through the gap, it becomes inverted (IFVG).

order_block_ob.bullish_ob: The last down-close (bearish) candle before an impulsive upward displacement that creates an FVG and breaks structure (BOS/MSS).
order_block_ob.bearish_ob: The last up-close (bullish) candle before an impulsive downward displacement that creates an FVG and breaks structure.
order_block_ob.invalidation: Stop loss is placed beyond the extreme wick of the Order Block candle.

liquidity_sweeps.buy_side_liquidity_bsl: Resting stop orders above equal highs (EQH), old swing highs, or session highs.
liquidity_sweeps.sell_side_liquidity_ssl: Resting stop orders below equal lows (EQL), old swing lows, or session lows.
liquidity_sweeps.sweep_confirmation: Price pierces liquidity level with wick but closes back inside range within 1-2 candles, indicating absorption rather than expansion.

premium_discount_equilibrium.premium_zone: Price > Equilibrium. Look ONLY for short entries or TP exits.
premium_discount_equilibrium.discount_zone: Price < Equilibrium. Look ONLY for long entries or TP exits.

optimal_trade_entry_ote.rule: Long entries require retracement into 0.618-0.786 discount range overlapping an unmitigated bullish OB or FVG. Short entries require retracement into 0.618-0.786 premium range overlapping an unmitigated bearish OB or FVG.
